turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Lim speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Tan here. I've got my portfolio notes in front of me. I'm between meetings, so I thought I'd call while I've got a quiet room.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Adrian. Certainly. Before we get into your notes, I'll need your identification details for the account checks. Please give me your identification number and date of birth.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Give me a moment while I bring up your account. No need to rush through your papers while I'm doing that.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, I've found the page I was looking for. [[EV_008]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'm here, Adrian. Take a moment with your notes if you need it; there's no need to speak over the background noise.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_009]] Sorry, I had two pages open beside each other. Let me put the old sheet aside so I don't keep looking at it.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For any follow-up call, what arrangement would be convenient? I can leave a neutral callback message if you're tied up, without putting account details into it.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: After lunch is usually better. If I don't pick up, just leave your name and ask me to ring the bank. My phone is normally on silent during meetings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's fine. I'll note the callback preference. Would you prefer that we avoid calling while you're travelling, or is your usual mobile still the best way to reach you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Usual mobile is best. I'm staying in Singapore for now. We've got a family gathering coming up, so most of my spare time has gone into organising that.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Sounds like a busy week outside work as well. Are you hosting everyone at home, or meeting somewhere so there's less organising on your side?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: At my parents' place, actually. My sister is sorting out the food, and I'm helping with the chairs and picking up the older relatives. Quite a bit of coordination, lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Yes, getting everyone together takes some planning. I'll keep any callback message brief, then, so you can return it when you're somewhere quiet rather than interrupting the family.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, that's helpful. A short message is enough. Sometimes I see missed calls only after I've finished driving, and I'd rather call back properly than talk on the road.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Of course. You can reach me through the bank's usual line and ask for Rachel Lim. I'll leave you to your next meeting now. Thank you for calling, Adrian.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. I've got to head back in now. Have a good afternoon. Bye.
